name: Media players (Spotify, browsers, VLC, mpv…)

1.how: org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.* on the session bus: playerctl -l | play-pause | next | previous | position | metadata | volume; busctl --user call org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify /org/mpris/MediaPlayer2 org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.Player Pause
1.notes: Every desktop player and every browser tab playing media implements MPRIS. No UI needed for playback, and 'what is playing' is a property read.

3.how: Spotify (Electron) needs --force-renderer-accessibility; search and playlists are then reachable by name. VLC (Qt) has a full tree.

quirks: playerctl is a small extra package (pacman -S playerctl); busctl works without it.
